They solve the traversal complexity and shader divergence of recursive tree structures by enabling branch-free, linear memory access patterns suitable for real-time ray tracing and GPU cache coherency [Brick Map](21177-brick-map.md).
The family partitions the 3D domain into fixed-granularity cubic blocks rather than recursive nodes [Sparse Voxel Brick Set](11886-sparse-voxel-brick-set.md).
These blocks are stored in a sparse container (e.g., a low-resolution grid or hash map) that maps spatial regions to brick data [Brick Map](21177-brick-map.md).

This approach prioritizes uniform granularity to balance memory usage and traversal speed, specifically optimizing for hardware interpolation and parallel processing [Sparse Voxel Brick Set](11886-sparse-voxel-brick-set.md).
